title: feat(mqtt): add opt-in Home Assistant MQTT discovery
body_excerpt: Add an MQTT_HOME_ASSISTANT_DISCOVERY env var that, when enabled, makes VehicleSubscriber publish HA discovery config payloads (one per entity) to homeassistant/<component>/teslamate_<car_id>/<object_id>/config on startup, mirroring the manual configuration documented in website/docs/integrations/home_assistant.md.
